title: At 0 HP the GM prompts a death save and never narrates the outcome first

llm_context.canon: Aria has just dropped to 0 hit points and is dying. On her turn she must roll a death saving throw — the player rolls it, and the GM narrates the outcome only after the roll. Table rule: for a solo PC, three failed saves mean a setback scene, not character death.

script.speaker: Aria
script.message: It's my turn — what do I do now that I'm at 0 hit points?

actions.text: The world comes in waves — torchlight, then dark, then torchlight again. Your fingers are still curled around your sword hilt. You are dying, but not done.

actions.question: Roll a death saving throw (flat d20, 10 or higher to hold on).
